column1: # Owner -> subsystem map for tools/coverage.py (RE side). One row per owner pattern; the FIRST matching row wins.
#   pattern    fnmatch glob (case-sensitive) on the owner: a class or namespace ("cSC4PowerSimulator",
#              "nSGLDX7::cGDriver"; nested classes match their parent's pattern with "*"), or "fn:<name>" for a free
#   subsystem  the row's name in the report (several rows may share one)
#   area       simulation | framework | renderer | ui | audio | region | other
#   spec       docs/specs files that specify this owner as their subject, comma-separated, or - . A spec that only
#              mentions a class, or covers one method of it, does not count (short forms count for what they list)
#   core       engine/ paths of the clean-room module(s) that implement it (core/src/..., formats/src/...), or -
#   shadow     the ini key of the same-process shadow that compares it with the original, or -
#   replace    the ini enable key (engine/plugin/FC4Subsystems.cpp) that swaps the original class for ours, or -
# Status rules (tools/coverage.py, docs/COVERAGE.md): specified = every listed spec file exists; implemented = every
# listed core path exists; verified = the shadow is in the regress shadows list and exact (every line clean) in the
# regress .out read; replaced = the key is in the regress replace list (or on by default) and the replace run was clean.
# ---- simulation: simulators and developers with a spec, a core, a shadow or a replacement
# cVecRange: the series range walk of history.md §4.6 (HW6, constructor 0x00475B00); only the history warehouse calls it
# grid iterators used by several simulators: the random cell iterator (GetNext 0x0049CB10; weather.md §6.7, simgrid.md §7.4,
# core grid/random_iter.rs) and the spiral iterator (0x0043FE10; simgrid.md §7.4, plumbing.md §7.2, core plumbing NearestWater
# ---- simulation: city managers specified (cores without glue, or no core yet)
# the network lot and its configuration object, each a section of network-manager.md (§2.3 vtable 0x00AA78E0,
# IID 0x89A5BA66; §2.4 vtable 0x00AA7998), implemented by core/src/network_manager (lots.rs, config.rs). They are
# listed before the cSC4Network* catch-all, which would otherwise file them under network occupants
# the save-game object file (0x005D9490-0x005DC0xx: cSC4AutoLoad/AutoSave streams and records, then the typed stream
# operators, then SC4OpenSaveGame / SC4ReadBinaryRecord); the operators are called from the Read / Write of the simulators'
# records (weather, traffic, residential, flora, sim grids, automata, effects, occupants). Two operator<< overloads of the
# same name live elsewhere (0x005192E0 automata, 0x005AFFF0 effects resource, 1,110 bytes) and share the owner. No spec
# the generator (class 0x4A1628C5) and attractor (0x6A1628BA) controller records of automata.md §3.5, specified as
# records (Write / Read addresses and fields) and implemented by core/src/automata (controller.rs). Only these two of
# the vehicle-side classes are specified: automata.md §0 says the short form covers the records and the hooks, not
# movement, path following or animation, so the rest of this block keeps spec -

column4: occupant-manager.md, lot-records.md, prop-occupant.md, flora.md, landfill.md, disasters.md
